notes: U1 value 'matte black' on an already dark grey fence -> dark green colour; U2/U3/U4 refs vague in a crowded shopfront, rewritten with landmarks (verified on clean crop); U4 payload 'blue plaque on a sign' odd -> small blue sticker.
